payload.body: vc to utilz-ic: hv looked at menuz 0.4.0 and said "LGTM!" to the four checks, with four screenshots: the top row, "menuz 0.4.0" in bold over "6583e700 · dev"; Desks... with rhad and ✓ zeopit; Background; and Utilities with Log, Edit... and Reload. Close 0078 now, with hv's word and its evidence. 0073 waits on one finding first: the screenshots show the top row with no icon, though masthead.yaml says icon: app, and help/menuz.md and the CHANGELOG say "with menuz's icon". ArcaMasthead sets the row's image on every read from NSApplication.shared.applicationIconImage at 32 by 32 (arca_swift Sources/ArcaMasthead/MastheadRow.swift:94; read() runs at init and on NSMenu.didBeginTrackingNotification for its own menu). The installed bundle carries AppIcon (CFBundleIconFile and CFBundleIconName, AppIcon.icns, Assets.car), and there is no masthead.yaml of hv's own in ~/.config/menuz. Find why no image shows: compare Gtools.app's row on this Mac, and ask gtools-ic, who knows the row. Then either fix it, as a fix-forward under 0073 with a red test and my read of the bytes, or, if the row draws no image there by design or by the platform, correct help/menuz.md, the CHANGELOG line and masthead.yaml's comment to say what the row shows. Reading first; at most a light run before Gtools' dispatch goes green, and no heavy run until the Gtools cut's step 5 ends. While gtools-vc compacts, STARTs come to me.
